10216|1147bc15.name: Gubber Blump
10216|1147bc15.text: ...pan fried, deep fried, and stir fried...

10219|572db4df.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
10219|572db4df.text: May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.

11865|7022eed4.name: Buliwyf Stonehand
11865|7022eed4.text: Ye want to be trained in the use of a weapon, do ye?  Well don't stand there slack-jawed, speak up laddie!

11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

11867|d85affd4.name: Woo Ping
11867|d85affd4.text:
Buliwyf, the dwarven weapon master at the Timberline Arms in Ironforge, teaches fist weapons, guns, one and two-handed axes and one and two-handed maces.

Bixi Wobblebonk, the gnome weapon master at the Timberline Arms in Ironforge, teaches crossbow, daggers and throwing weapons.

Ilyenia Moonfire, the night elf weapon master, resides at the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus where she teaches bow, daggers, fist weapons, staff and throwing weapons.

1257|ed056522.name: Keldric Boucher
1257|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1265|a0959aba.name: Rudra Amberstill
1265|a0959aba.text: Welcome to the Amberstill Corral.  If you're interested in purchasing a mount, my husband Veron will be more than happy to help you choose just the right beast.  If you're looking for adventure, well we sure could use some help around here. . .

1285|ed056522.name: Thurman Mullby
1285|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1286|fe52f4ea.name: Edna Mullby
1286|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1287|fe52f4ea.name: Marda Weller
1287|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

12997|6ce695f2.name: Monty
12997|6ce695f2.text: Monty be me name an' rats be me game.

1301|fe52f4ea.name: Julia Gallina
1301|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

13084|554a4659.name: Bixi Wobblebonk
13084|554a4659.text: Well hi there!  Are you here to learn the proper technique of a new weapon?

1323|877c4b1d.name: Osric Strang
1323|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1340|76d04af9.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|76d04af9.text:
Welcome to Thelsamar, your home away from home in Loch Modan!

Thelsamar is a nice place, but it's not all beer and salted meat for those who answer the call to duty!  If you're willing to face danger in the name of the Alliance, then read the poster outside the Thelsamar branch of the Explorers' League.

1341|877c4b1d.name: Wilhelm Strang
1341|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1343|5751dde2.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1343|5751dde2.text:
Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

1351|a96dc031.name: Brother Cassius
1351|a96dc031.text: May the light guide your path and aid you in your journies. If you need any assistance browsing, I will be right over here.

1355|0c543544.name: Cook Ghilm
1355|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1432|e214cf62.name: Renato Gallina
1432|e214cf62.text: Hey, mister.  You look like a $C with discerning tastes in wine.  I have a favor to ask, and I think I can make you an offer you can't refuse...forget about it!

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1632|fee38227.name: Adele Fielder
1632|fee38227.text: Since my husband left for the front, Helene here has been my strength. Her kind heart and sharp sword have helped me through a lot of tough times. I don't know what I would've done without her.

1651|c2467ddc.name: Lee Brown
1651|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

1976|4e0ec384.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|4e0ec384.text: Which profession trainer are you looking for?

1976|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

1976|aa702ef3.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|aa702ef3.text: Gelman Stonehand would be the one to talk to. I think he has a house over in the Dwarven District but I can't remember exactly. I would check over there.

2327|2957a3a0.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

2327|33af2c00.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|33af2c00.text: I've heard it said that Deneb Walker, holed up in Stromgarde, has a book that is sure to help improve your First Aid techniques.

2329|33af2c00.name: Michelle Belle
2329|33af2c00.text: I've heard it said that Deneb Walker, holed up in Stromgarde, has a book that is sure to help improve your First Aid techniques.

2329|a28d29e1.name: Michelle Belle
2329|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

237|7ae4f953.name: Farmer Furlbrow
237|7ae4f953.text: Nothing but trouble in these parts.  I tried to tell that fool Saldean to get out while he still could be he won't hear of it.  But I ain't no fool.  Verna and I are gonna mosey on out as soon as we get this wagon fixed.

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

2455|105cd232.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2455|2237a3b1.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

253|e8768bd6.name: William Pestle
253|e8768bd6.text: Aha!  Good day, good day, Master $C!  Come, sit down and have a drink.  You have an enterprising look in your eye, and I think you'll find speaking to me worth your time...

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

258043|c6710551.name: Norric Lochthane
258043|c6710551.text: Ye've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around ye and ye shall fare far greater than most.

261|a2b799cb.name: Guard Thomas
261|a2b799cb.text: Hello, citizen.  You look like a man with a purpose - do you have business with the Stormwind Army?

264936|6ba63b30.name: Earthseer Farsen
264936|6ba63b30.text: On a clear day, you can even see Blackrock Mountain from here. It's both beautiful and terrifying at the same time.

268047|53fff4bc.name: Theramore Emissary
268047|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

277|ed056522.name: Roberto Pupellyverbos
277|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3649|17d06d6c.name: Thundris Windweaver
3649|17d06d6c.text: Dark forces encroach upon our borders, ancient taints resurface, and new evils emerge to topple the delicate balance of the land. In times of such darkness, we all must be vigilant.

3666|baf00edb.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
3666|baf00edb.text: Hmm... I can plug this wire in here and that will power the fizzletan gear, but then the hydrophlange will need an alternate power source... Maybe I can... Oh, hello! Hey, want to help me try a new invention?

3693|85fc41cc.name: Terenthis
3693|85fc41cc.text:
$N, I've come to find out how rampant the effects of Fel Moss are throughout Darkshore. The corruption of Teldrassil and our surrounding lands really concerns the druids of the Cenarian Circle, and all Night elves.

It is my goal to find out why this has happened and to put an end to it.

3702|5ae56d71.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
3702|5ae56d71.text: Hello $r, it is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

4200|c2e88775.name: Laird
4200|c2e88775.text: Although the coast of Darkshore is more dangerous than that of Teldrassil, many fishers find profit here.

491|02f3f1d4.name: Quartermaster Lewis
491|02f3f1d4.text: I try to keep Sentinel Hill stocked, and that's not easy with all the action we see.

514|9b2500eb.name: Smith Argus
514|9b2500eb.text: Of course I can help you with training. I'm just a journeyman myself, but I'm sure there's something I can show you.

5159|9af6c3de.name: Daryl Riknussun
5159|9af6c3de.text: I keep 'em fed, kid. Yep, Daryl Riknussun, at yer service.

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5492|837f02f9.name: Katherine the Pure
5492|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

5494|fe52f4ea.name: Catherine Leland
5494|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

5511|5ca9cced.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|5ca9cced.text: Ye have the look of a Blacksmith to ye. Soot under the nails, steel in yer bones. Aye, very much the blood of a Blacksmith in yer veins. Which means ye've come to me looking to learn a thing or two, well lad grab a hammer. Let's see what I can teach ye.

5512|211be282.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5513|451d1c98.name: Gelman Stonehand
5513|451d1c98.text: I came from Ironforge to help out with the rebuilding effort here. If I can teach enough of ye my skills then maybe I can leave it to ye and take myself back home.

6171|75f20abb.name: Duthorian Rall
6171|75f20abb.text:
You will be tested many times by the darkness that surrounds our lands, BUBBLES. But to ensure you are always prepared, we will often ask tasks of you so you are at the height of your own power.

Go with the Light, and remain virtuous.

6301|7a1efc7f.name: Gorbold Steelhand
6301|7a1efc7f.text: Greetings lad, if you're looking for the best deals you'll find outside of Ironforge itself, then you've come to the right place.

6734|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Hearthstove
6734|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

6737|41276936.name: Innkeeper Shaussiy
6737|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

7232|2ebb471e.name: Borgus Steelhand
7232|2ebb471e.text: What are ye daft? That's not a weapon, that's a dinner knife. I don't train amateurs.

925|837f02f9.name: Brother Sammuel
925|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

927|837f02f9.name: Brother Wilhelm
927|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

928|837f02f9.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

957|8622dd6f.name: Dane Lindgren
957|8622dd6f.text: You're not bad, but let me show you a few tricks you might find handy.

957|a7a421b8.name: Dane Lindgren
957|a7a421b8.text: A far better blacksmith than I am, that's for sure. Though I'll deny it if you tell anyone I said that. You should go speak with Therum Deepforge. If anyone can teach you more, it's him.

963|287add49.name: Deputy Rainer
963|287add49.text:
Hello, $C.  I hope you've come to bolster our ranks.  Beasts and thieves are spilling into our beloved Elwynn, and we barely have enough men to keep the roads safe!

And if you haven't done so, read that notice about Hogger.  He's a beast in yonder woods that must be dealt with.

1001-accept.name: Unknown
1001-accept.text:
A tiny voice crackles from deep within the machine.

"Wizbang here! The next Buzzbox is north of Auberdine, on the beach

So, that Buzzbox is number 411 and it needs 3 Thresher Eyes for its repairs. They're just off the coast! The darkshore threshers... *Hic*... Sorry about that...

Just like last time, when you give the Buzzbox the goods, it'll spit out your reward. *Hic*... What? No, I'm fine!"
1001-accept.title: Buzzbox 411

1001-complete.name: Unknown
1001-complete.text:
The Buzzbox hums to life soon after you place the Thresher Eyes inside. There is a moment of static before you hear a familiar tiny voice call out.

"Crawler wine is the best..." *hic*

"What? Oh, you fixed it already? Wow, you're a fasht one. Sho, would ya like to fix another?"

You believe you hear a liquid being poured into a cup, followed by loud gulping sounds.
1001-complete.title: Buzzbox 411

1001-progress.name: Unknown
1001-progress.text: The machine's hatch is open and it seems to wait expectantly for 3 Thresher Eyes to be placed inside.
1001-progress.title: Buzzbox 411

1002-accept.name: Unknown
1002-accept.text:
The Buzzbox gives a burst of static as you hear Wizbang begin to speak.

"The next Buzzbox is number 323. Ish north of Auberdine but... where's the ale? Wha? Oh, ish on the road sho ya shouldn't have trouble finding it near the bridge."

Wizbang mumbles something incoherent before you hear a loud gulping sound.

"Thish one needs Moonstalker Fangs... 6 of 'em."
1002-accept.title: Buzzbox 323

1002-complete.name: Unknown
1002-complete.text:
The Buzzbox suddenly leaps into action, and you can hear the distinct sounds of teeth being ground to dust coming from within.

"Sho, ya made it! Thatsh exshellent newsh... Sho... Why doncha move along? Oh! Unless you want another job!"
1002-complete.title: Buzzbox 323

1002-progress.name: Unknown
1002-progress.text: Though you have yet to place the 6 Moonstalker Fangs inside, you believe you hear the sounds of static and incoherent gnome ramblings coming from within. Could someone else have fixed the machine already?
1002-progress.title: Buzzbox 323

1003-accept.name: Unknown
1003-accept.text:
Over the boiling noises and dripping sounds coming from the machine, you hear Wizbang's wavering voice call out.

"Nexsht onesh far south down the road. Shouldn't be hard to find... jusht off to the shide... near a fensh. I think I hid it in shum bushesh... Bushessh. Hehehe... Yesh, Buzzbox 525 takes grizzled scalps from thoshe grizzled thistle bears. Boy thash a mouthful. Grizzshled... Hehehe..."

You hear more gulping sounds as the machine cuts out. Then, suddenly, it bursts back to life.

"4!"
1003-accept.title: Buzzbox 525

102-accept.name: Captain Danuvin
102-accept.text:
Stormwind has abandoned us.  A foul wind of depravity rustles through the plains of Westfall.  This was my homeland and I will not turn my back on the citizens who choose to remain here.  We, the former farmers, shall make our stand.

Your task, should you choose to accept, is to patrol the grasslands of Westfall.  Track down and slay the vile Gnolls that seem to be working in conjunction with the Deadmines thieves. Bring me eight Gnoll Paws and I will reward your bravery.
102-accept.title: Patrolling Westfall

106-accept.name: Maybell Maclure
106-accept.text:
Oh, I'm cursed!  My heart belongs to Tommy Joe Stonefield, but our families are bitter enemies.  So I can't see him, even though my eyes ache to gaze upon that handsome face!

Please, take this letter and give it to Tommy Joe.  He's usually at the river to the west of the Stonefield Farm, which is due west of here.
106-accept.title: Young Lovers

106-complete.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-complete.text: Ah!  I can't stand us being apart.  I have to see her!!
106-complete.title: Young Lovers

106-progress.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-progress.text: You have what??  Maybell is the light of my dull life.  Hurry, let me see her letter!
106-progress.title: Young Lovers

107-accept.name: Gramma Stonefield
107-accept.text:
I bet William Pestle has a potion to unite our two young lovers!

Here, take this note to William.  He's staying at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
107-accept.title: Note to William

107-complete.name: William Pestle
107-complete.text:
My heart goes out to those two poor souls, Maybell and Tommy Joe.  I remember being young and in love, once.

There must be something I can do to help them!  Let me think...
107-complete.title: Note to William

107-progress.name: William Pestle
107-progress.text: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh?  I haven't seen Mildred in years!  I wonder what she has to say...
107-progress.title: Note to William

109-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
109-accept.text: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, $c.  If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle.  He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall.  I bet he could use your help.  You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.
109-accept.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

109-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
109-complete.text:
Ah, so my friend sent you here?  How kind.  

Well the Stormwind Monarchy has abandoned our cause.  Now it is up to the People's Militia to keep the land free from corruption.  If our cause interests you, I can put your combat skills to use in the name of freedom.
109-complete.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

1097-accept.name: Smith Argus
1097-accept.text:
There's a dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind, Grimand Elmore, who sent word that he needs help with a delivery.  I believe he wants a package sent to his homeland in the north.

You have a sturdy pair on you!  So if you're interested in some legwork then speak with Grimand.  We could use you down here, but we must also keep our ties strong with the dwarves.

You can find Grimand Elmore at the weapon shop in the Dwarven District of Stormwind, in the northeast section of town.
1097-accept.title: Elmore's Task

1097-complete.name: Grimand Elmore
1097-complete.text: You're here to help with my delivery?  Very good!
1097-complete.title: Elmore's Task

11-accept.name: Deputy Rainer
11-accept.text:
Gnolls, brutish creatures with no decent business in these lands, have been seen along the borders of Elwynn Forest.  A large pack of them, many more than we can handle alone, have infested the woods south of the guard tower yonder.  Another group has infested the areas near Stone Cairn Lake to the east.

The Stormwind Army will commend whomever helps kill them.  Bring me their painted gnoll armbands as proof of your deed.
11-accept.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

111-accept.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
111-accept.text:
Please, $N, talk with my Gramma.  If anyone can find a way to bring me together with Maybell, she can.

She's inside our house east of here.
111-accept.title: Speak with Gramma

111-complete.name: Gramma Stonefield
111-complete.text:
While our families are feuding, Tommy Joe and Maybell don't have much of a future, but... maybe we can get them together for just a little while.

Hm, what can we do...
111-complete.title: Speak with Gramma

112-accept.name: William Pestle
112-accept.text:
I can make an invisibility liquor for Maybell, so she can slip away from the Maclure Vineyards and go to Tommy Joe.  But to make the Liquor, I need some crystal kelp.

Although the kelp usually grows in the ocean... sometimes murlocs collect it.  See if the murlocs near Crystal Lake have any.  Crystal Lake is just east of Goldshire.
112-accept.title: Collecting Kelp

112-complete.name: William Pestle
112-complete.text: You got them.  Good show!  Now, just one moment while I concoct the potion...
112-complete.title: Collecting Kelp

112-progress.name: William Pestle
112-progress.text: Do you have that crystal kelp?  I'm sure Maybell is anxious to see her beau...
112-progress.title: Collecting Kelp

1138-accept.name: Gubber Blump
1138-accept.text:
I love crab.  Crabs are the fruit of the sea!  You can bake it, barbecue it, boil it, and broil it.  They're pan fried, deep fried, and stir fried.  There's crab salad, crab soup, crab stew, pepper crab, lemon crab, whipper root crab, and Ironforge surprise crab.  That's... that's about it.

I'm here fishing right now, so I can't get any fine crab chunks.  You can pick them out of reef crawlers and encrusted tide crawlers.  You can make a lot with it.  You can bake it, barbecue it, boil it...
1138-accept.title: Fruit of the Sea

1138-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1138-progress.text:
...lemon crab, whipper root crab, and Ironforge surprise crab.  That's about it.

Oh, hello there $N.  Do you have them fine crab chunks I was telling you about?
1138-progress.title: Fruit of the Sea

114-accept.name: William Pestle
114-accept.text: Take this invisibility liquor to young Maybell.  It should last long enough for her to visit Tommy Joe.
114-accept.title: The Escape

114-complete.name: Maybell Maclure
114-complete.text:
Oh...my!  I feel guilty deceiving my family, but my feelings for Tommy Joe are too strong to ignore.

Thank you, $N.  I'll drink this liquor as soon as I have the chance and sneak away to my love.

And for you... please take this.
114-complete.title: The Escape

114-progress.name: Maybell Maclure
114-progress.text: Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe?  What did he say??
114-progress.title: The Escape

1141-accept.name: Gubber Blump
1141-accept.text:
I love fishing.  The Blump family is known for fishing.  My name is Gubber Blump; I fish.

There's a kind of fish I like to catch around these parts called Darkshore grouper.  I used to go out on a boat to fish for grouper, but no boats have been going out since them mean ol' murlocs moved in.  I bet they been eating up all the grouper too.

Say, you wanna help me catch Darkshore grouper?  I'd give you a bona fide Blump Family Fishing Pole if you did!  It's a real good pole to catch fish with.
1141-accept.title: The Family and the Fishing Pole

1141-complete.name: Gubber Blump
1141-complete.text:
Them's some real nice groupers, $N!  Thanks for helping me out!

You're at least as good of a fisherman as my cousin, Graun Blump.  She also has a beard and she smells kinda funny, but that don't do nothing to stop her fishing.  I reckon you have what it takes to use a Blump Family Fishing Pole.
1141-complete.title: The Family and the Fishing Pole

1141-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1141-progress.text:
There's plenty of good dishes you use Darkshore groupers for.  They're good to eat, but I think it's more fun catching them.

You caught any Darkshore groupers yet?
1141-progress.title: The Family and the Fishing Pole

12-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-accept.text:
The People's Militia has but one goal:  To defend the lands of Westfall and return peace to our surroundings.  Unfortunately, the price of peace is often blood. 

One of my scouts has brought word of a band of Defias Trappers wreaking havoc nearby.  I have reports of Defias Trapper sightings near the Jangolode Mine to the Northwest as well as at the Molsen Farm and Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm. If you seek to join our ranks, slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me.
12-accept.title: The People's Militia

1338-accept.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1338-accept.text:
There is a dwarven armorsmith whose work I admire greatly.  His name is Furen Longbeard, and his skill is unmatched.  I need a new shield, and I must have one of his!

The problem is... Furen is far to the south, in the dwarven district within Stormwind.  In $r lands!  I can't imagine why he would live there, so far from Ironforge.  The humans must pay him a king's ransom to keep him there!

So, if you want to travel and don't mind making some money, then will you send Furen my request for a shield?
1338-accept.title: Stormpike's Order

1338-complete.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-complete.text:
Ah, a request from one of the Stormpikes.  That's a proud clan, full of quality dwarves.  Rich ones, too.

Thank you, $N.  I'll get to work on Mountaineer Stormpike's shield by the end of the day.
1338-complete.title: Stormpike's Order

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

1339-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1339-accept.text:
I hear Mountaineer Stormpike is looking for a runner.  Someone to do a little traveling for him.  How about it?  Are you the $r for the job?

If so, then you'll find Stormpike at the top of the northern guard tower.
1339-accept.title: Mountaineer Stormpike's Task

1339-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1339-complete.text:
That's right.  I have a task that I can't do while I'm guarding.  In fact, it'll take you far from Loch Modan.

Your perfect chance for adventure!
1339-complete.title: Mountaineer Stormpike's Task

151-accept.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-accept.text:
Poor Old Blanchy!  Such a tired beast after all the work we put her through. I fed her before we left the farm, but we weren't expecting the wagon to break on us. If you could bring her a few handfuls of oats from the fields, I'd be grateful.

I bet you could find some around all of the farms in Westfall, if you can steer clear of those horrific machines that have taken over. There are several farms southwest of here.
151-accept.title: Poor Old Blanchy

1579-accept.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1579-accept.text:
I came to Auberdine because of the quiet.  I want to invent my inventions where it's quiet, because after a night of drinking I don't like all the noise of Ironforge!

So I took a ship to Auberdine and had a little too much to drink on the way.  I dropped my box of gaffer jacks overboard!  I need my gaffer jacks!

I don't know exactly where I dropped them, but if you fish for them in the ocean you might get lucky...
1579-accept.title: Gaffer Jacks

16-complete.name: Gerard Tiller
16-complete.text: Thanks, $N!  And come back if you want to trade again.
16-complete.title: Give Gerard a Drink

16-progress.name: Gerard Tiller
16-progress.text:
Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water.

If you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade.
16-progress.title: Give Gerard a Drink

1641-complete.name: Duthorian Rall
1641-complete.text:
Here in Stormwind, I am responsible for putting paladins on the path to greater virtue as they devote themselves to the Light and defend Azeroth from the Scourge and other threats.

The time has come for you to take your first step towards being truly virtuous. If you accept it, I will give you a Book of Divinity. In studying it, you shall learn some about the Light, and what is expected of you. If you understand it, and are capable, then you will succeed in attaining greater abilities.
1641-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1642-accept.name: Unknown
1642-accept.text:
In all things, a $c must reflect the Light which supplements our strength. To strive to be divine for one of our kind does not mean we strive for godhood--we strive to be good in all actions.

Although called upon to smite evil in these harsh times, you must always remember that it's aiding others that will truly set you apart from the citizens of Azeroth. Compassion, patience, bravery--these things mean as much to a $c as strength in battle.

Know this well, and never forget it.
1642-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1642-complete.name: Duthorian Rall
1642-complete.text:
Hello again, $N. How goes your studies of the Tome of Divinity?

Then you should be prepared to have yourself tested. There are always tasks to be done throughout the city and our lands; acts of compassion and understanding; people who need help; creatures to slay.

By proving you have the patience to help others, especially those who are less fortunate, you prove that you are a servant of the Light and of sound mind.
1642-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1643-accept.name: Duthorian Rall
1643-accept.text:
Your task then, $N, is to find someone here in Stormwind that is in need of aid. Someone who is pure of heart and motive. Perhaps someone helping others. Perhaps someone in need of a guide. Regardless, the person must have noble intent and be relying on your kindness.

Do this, and return to me when you are finished. Then, we shall discuss more of your path and what it means to be a $c of the Light.
1643-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1643-complete.name: Stephanie Turner
1643-complete.text:
Oh, hello, luv. How go your adventures? Oh, I'm so glad to hear you're doing well.

Oh, me? Thank you for asking--I'm doing well, all things considered.

The increase in tradesmen has kind of put a damper on the amount of leather and cloth people are willing to part with these days, so it's been tougher to make clothing for the children at the orphanage, but we'll manage. By "we" I mean my husband and I. He's up in Ironforge trying to seek help from the citizens there.
1643-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1644-accept.name: Stephanie Turner
1644-accept.text:
Bless their hearts, most of them have no families because of the Scourge attacks in the last decade.

My husband John collects the materials for me to make the shirts and pants for the children, but I haven't even had time to do that. I've been too focused on keeping food on their plates, and a roof over their heads.

What's that? You'd be willing to help? Oh, thank the Light, and thank you, $N.

If you could bring me some linen cloth so I can sew clothes for the kids, that would help me out so much.
1644-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1644-complete.name: Stephanie Turner
1644-complete.text:
Thank you, $N, thank you so much!

The children will be so pleased, and you've saved me so much time. I'll now be able to focus on the children's other needs, and hopefully my John will be able to return home sooner than we thought.

Thank you again, $N. I knew I could rely on the charity of others. The Light be with you.
1644-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1644-progress.name: Stephanie Turner
1644-progress.text:
I hope my John is having better luck in Ironforge. He so dislikes his trips there because it leaves the kids and me alone, but he knows it must be done. He's so kind-hearted.

Some years have been easier than others, but this one's been rougher by far. It's almost as though something in the air is signaling a huge change. Who knows though?
1644-progress.title: The Tome of Divinity

176-accept.name: Unknown
176-accept.text:
Wanted: Hogger

A huge gnoll, Hogger, is prowling the woods in southwestern Elwynn.  He has overpowered all attempts at his capture.

The Stormwind Army has placed a generous bounty on the Gnoll.  To earn the reward, bounty hunters should bring proof of Hogger's demise to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
176-accept.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

1780-accept.name: Stephanie Turner
1780-accept.text:
I'll take these to the children this very day. Please be safe, good $c. It is not often men of your character show their faces in the city, but you've proven that the paladins here in Stormwind shall never turn their backs on those in need.

Farewell.
1780-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1780-complete.name: Duthorian Rall
1780-complete.text:
You've returned so quickly, $N. And what have you accomplished in your time away from the Cathedral?

Have you helped a noble cause? Perhaps you've learned the value of charity or some more about your obligations to the citizens of Azeroth. Tell me, who have you helped and how.... Well, I'm impressed, $N, those are surely the actions of one who follows the Light and values others above oneself.

Such sacrifice will always be rewarded in time.
1780-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1781-accept.name: Duthorian Rall
1781-accept.text:
Take this, $N. It is called the Symbol of Life.

You've proven charitable and patient, and now the time has come to see if you're powerful enough to focus one of the Light's greatest gifts.

My friend Gazin returned recently from an encounter with some Defias in Elwynn near Heroes' Vigil--he barely escaped with his life. He's near the altar having his wounds healed by our priests.

Take the Symbol and speak to him. If you can help him, then we will speak again soon. May you bask in the Light's glory.
1781-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1781-complete.name: Gazin Tenorm
1781-complete.text:
*cough*

Pleasure to meet you, $c. Don't mind my wounds, the good priest here can take care of ol' Gazin this time. I won't be needing the power of that Symbol of Life you've got there... not yet anyway.

So, Duthorian sent you to speak to me, huh? Fair enough. I'll tell you exactly what befell me and my friend Henze. And with any luck, and some skill on your part, perhaps you can still help us all.
1781-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1786-accept.name: Gazin Tenorm
1786-accept.text:
Henze and I had made it to Heroes' Vigil, an island in the middle of Stone Cairn Lake in northeastern Elwynn. We'd heard the Defias had infiltrated our borders and we wanted proof to take to the king's advisors.

We caught sight of a couple of the scum going over some documents, and we attacked. Unfortunately, we were quickly overwhelmed by more of the mages.

Henze held them off for me while I escaped... the daft fool, going and being brave.

He's out there now, Henze is. Can you help us, $N?
1786-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1786-complete.name: Henze Faulk
1786-complete.text:
Thank you, brother.

Seeing you wield the Symbol of Life, may I assume Duthorian or Gazin sent you?

I fell to the Defias spell casters while Gazin and I tried to get their plans from them: I was able to hold on long enough to allow Gazin to escape, but in the end, their magics overwhelmed me.

But you were able to bring me back: the ability to use the Symbol doesn't come to just anyone, $N. It bodes well for you that you were able to empower it with your own faith.
1786-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1787-accept.name: Henze Faulk
1787-accept.text:
We'll have time to talk more about the Symbol at a later time. What's important now is to get those papers we saw the Defias going over. If we can get our hands on them, we'll be able to prove the Defias have infiltrated Elwynn and hopefully gain some insight into what their plans are.

I'm in no shape for battle as of now, $N. Do you think you're strong enough to get those papers from the Defias here on the island?

If you're able to get them, bring them back to Gazin and let him know I'm all right.
1787-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1787-complete.name: Gazin Tenorm
1787-complete.text: Wonderful! You made it, and saved Henze. The Light is with you for sure, $N!
1787-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1787-progress.name: Gazin Tenorm
1787-progress.text:
Is Henze safe, $N? Were you successful?

Between your skill with a weapon, and the power of the Light, I'd imagine Heroes' Vigil is safe from any Defias threat, but that's for the King and his advisors to say.
1787-progress.title: The Tome of Divinity

1788-accept.name: Gazin Tenorm
1788-accept.text:
I'll take the script to the King's advisors after Duthorian's taken a look at them, but in the meantime, you should go speak to Duthorian now. He'll be wanting to pat you on the back for sure!

Thank you again, $N. I hope we meet again. You're surely an ally I'm proud to call friend.
1788-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1788-complete.name: Duthorian Rall
1788-complete.text:
You've done well this day, $N. You should take some pride in what you've accomplished.

Even more so, you should be proud of your abilities. Not everyone can use the power of the Symbol of Life. Calling upon the Light to bring back the dead means you're prepared for one of the $c's greatest honors: the power of resurrection.

You shall have the power to bring back fallen companions much like you did for Henze.

Be well, $N. The Light shines upon you and you should welcome it wholly.
1788-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

184-accept.name: Unknown
184-accept.text:
This is the deed to an expanse of farmlands within Westfall.  It is signed by a Theodore Furlbrow and cosigned by his wife, Verna.  And on the back of the deed are hastily scrawled words:

"We leaned on Furlbrow and got his deed.  Thought it might be handy if you wanted to forge one of these for your own place.

The Furlbrows won't give us trouble.  Last I saw them they were on their way out of Westfall, stuck with a broken wagon."

You think the Furlbrows might want their deed back...
184-accept.title: Furlbrow's Deed

184-complete.name: Farmer Furlbrow
184-complete.text:
Loads of thanks, $N!  As I was saying, these parts aren't fit for honest folk anymore, but if things get better, then this deed will let us reclaim our land.

I don't have much to offer you, but here -- take this.
184-complete.title: Furlbrow's Deed

184-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
184-progress.text:
You have the deed to my farm??  That's good news!  Some ruffians stole it days ago... I thought it was gone for good!

Please, let me have it.  We're on our way out of Westfall and ain't coming back any time soon, but if we do then we'll need those papers...
184-progress.title: Furlbrow's Deed

2040-accept.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-accept.text:
Gnomeregan has fallen under the control of those dastardly troggs! The situation is grave but perhaps you can help, $N.

Deep in the Deadmines is a functional goblin shredder. Find that shredder and bring back the intact power supply. With the shredder's power supply, we can give our gyrodrillmatic excavationators the power they need to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan, opening the way for a gnomish assault!
2040-accept.title: Underground Assault

2118-accept.name: Tharnariun Treetender
2118-accept.text:
A sickness spreads across the Darkshore, gripping the minds and bodies of all it touches.

The Thistle Bears have been hit the hardest by this plague. The once noble beasts are now an instrument of destruction - rabid and frenzied. I may have a cure for this ailment.

Take this trap to the forest and lay it on the ground. Any Rabid Thistle Bear that crosses the light shall become docile for a short time. Once the bear is docile, it shall follow you. Lead it back here, $N.
2118-accept.title: Plagued Lands

2118-complete.name: Tharnariun Treetender
2118-complete.text: Our work has only just begun, $N. Are you prepared for your next task?
2118-complete.title: Plagued Lands

2138-accept.name: Tharnariun Treetender
2138-accept.text:
As I had feared, the cure does not work.

It saddens me greatly to order the death of any of nature's beasts, but the sick and tainted thistle bears must be put down.

Return to the forest and destroy 20 rabid thistle bears, $N. It will most certainly not put a stop to the plague but it will slow down the damage the animals are doing to our forest and its inhabitants for a short time.
2138-accept.title: Cleansing of the Infected

2178-accept.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
2178-accept.text:
Do you smell that delicious aroma? It's my secret recipe, $N--fresh strider stew. Delicious!

Perhaps you would be interested in learning the recipe?

Before I teach you the recipe, you will need to prove that you can handle the beasts.

Now, I don't expect you to go out and tame one and ride it back to me, but if you can kill a few and bring back some of their succulent meat, I may be persuaded to show you the ways of strider stew.
2178-accept.title: Easy Strider Living

22-accept.name: Salma Saldean
22-accept.text: The onions are peeled.  The garlic is minced.  The rosemary is crushed.  The crust has been baked.  The dill weed is chopped.  The gravy is simmering.  Now all I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-accept.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

22-progress.name: Salma Saldean
22-progress.text: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-progress.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

224-accept.name: Mountaineer Cobbleflint
224-accept.text:
We need to protect the Loch, $N!  With so many of the King's soldiers fighting valiantly on remote battlefields, we've become overwhelmed on the home front.  Troggs are tunneling up from every crevice!  The Trogg infestation poses the largest threat to Ironforge.  These disgusting mutants must be destroyed.

We need you, brave adventurer, to venture forth and lay waste to the Trogg threat.  Slay 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts and report back.
224-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

224-complete.name: Mountaineer Cobbleflint
224-complete.text:
Well done, $N!  You demonstrated uncanny courage on the battlefield.  Our war against the Troggs will be won with efforts such as yours.  You have served King Magni well.

If you fancy yourself well-suited for this kind of adventuring, I suggest you speak with Mountaineer Gravelgaw.  The Captain has him assigned to a rough patrol that I am sure he can use some help with.  Check with Gravelgaw just inside the tower.
224-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

239-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
239-accept.text:
The Garrison on our western border sends word of increasing gnoll and thief activity.  They're requesting we send more Stormwind soldiers... but we just don't have any to spare!

If you can help, we could use it.  Go and speak with Deputy Rainer at the Westbrook Garrison and see what he needs done.

The Garrison is down the road to the west.  After you cross the bridge over the small brook it will be to the right.
239-accept.title: Westbrook Garrison Needs Help!

239-complete.name: Deputy Rainer
239-complete.text:
Marshall Dughan sent you, eh?  Well you're not from the army, but if Dughan sent you then that's good enough for me!

Our situation is, to say the least, a stressed one.  I hope you can give us a hand.
239-complete.title: Westbrook Garrison Needs Help!

244-accept.name: Guard Parker
244-accept.text:
Hail, $c.  I am charged to patrol this stretch of road.  Although the road is safe for now, I've seen gnoll encampments to the north and east of here.

Lakeshire must know of the gathering gnoll force!  Report to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire and tell him of the gnolls.  Do this, and I'm sure Feldon will offer you a scout's wage.

Feldon's usually inspecting the area south of the bridge to Lakeshire.
244-accept.title: Encroaching Gnolls

244-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
244-complete.text:
There are Redridge gnolls that close to Elwynn??  They may be poised to advance into our homeland.  Soon the people of Lakeshire may not be the only humans under siege!

Here is your pay, though you bring us dire news.  And it comes at a bad time, for we are ill equipped to deal with it.
244-complete.title: Encroaching Gnolls

246-accept.name: Deputy Feldon
246-accept.text:
We don't have men to spare, but something must be done about those gnolls you reported to me.

Scout southern Redridge for gnolls.  Harry them, kill those you can and report back to me with a count of their numbers and an assessment of the threat they present.  You may find those gnolls camped all along the southern road of Redridge.

Do this for the Stormwind Army, $N, and you will be rewarded.
246-accept.title: Assessing the Threat

267-accept.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-accept.text:
$C, you may or may not be aware of the Trogg threat looming over Dwarven lands.  With the Ironforge Reserve called up to the Alliance Front, we are left with a fraction of the defense forces needed to keep these lands safe.  My regiment is assigned to watch over the Gate here and we cannot leave our post for fear of invasion.

But we need some pressure put on those damned Troggs lurking in the hills.  If you're up to the task, wage an assault on the Troggs.  Bring me back 8 Trogg Stone Teeth as proof.
267-accept.title: The Trogg Threat

267-complete.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-complete.text: I am quite impressed, $N.  You have done the Dwarven race a great favor by defending our lands.  King Magni Bronzebeard himself would be proud!
267-complete.title: The Trogg Threat

267-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-progress.text: Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me?  If not, there is still work to be done, $N.
267-progress.title: The Trogg Threat

2998-accept.name: Brother Wilhelm
2998-accept.text:
Greetings, brother. Duthorian Rall, one of our most influential paladins, was speaking about you recently. I overheard him talking about how it was time you be put to the test some... along with some very complimentary things about how well you've performed thus far.

If I were you, I'd head to Stormwind and speak to him when you have time. I'm sure he's in the Cathedral of Light--that's where he spends most of his time.
2998-accept.title: Tome of Divinity

2998-complete.name: Duthorian Rall
2998-complete.text:
It is beautiful here in Stormwind, is it not?

Your timing actually couldn't have been better, $N.
2998-complete.title: Tome of Divinity

307-accept.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-accept.text:
The Silver Stream Mine to the east ran dry long ago.  It was converted by the Miners' League into a storage depot, but now Kobolds have moved in, putting their filthy paws on good, Dwarven tools!

We'll root out those vermin soon enough, but the League wants someone to get their gear out of the mine before we warriors tromp in there and break things.  It'll be a tough delve - you might want cohorts at your side.

The gear is stored in Miners' League Crates throughout the mine.  Good luck.
307-accept.title: Filthy Paws

307-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-complete.text: Did you see a lot of Kobolds in there?  I can't wait for the order to clear them out of the mine.  The thought of their grimy hands clawing around our mine makes my stomach rumble!
307-complete.title: Filthy Paws

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

314-accept.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-accept.text:
We heard the cries in the middle of the night.  Then this morning, sure enough, the herd was missing two rams.  That dastardly beast known as Vagash has been preying on our livelihood.  With most of King Magni's army off in distant lands fighting with the Alliance, there is no one to keep Vagash at bay.

Perhaps you are brave enough to seek out the beast and slay him.  Bring me one of his fangs and I will reward you.  Vagash lurks just above the ranch here, but be warned, he is deadly.
314-accept.title: Protecting the Herd

314-complete.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-complete.text: Very well done!  Veron will be so happy when he hears the good news.  To kill Vagash is no easy task.  I imagine one day you'll be fighting alongside King Magni's men on the Alliance Front.
314-complete.title: Protecting the Herd

314-progress.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-progress.text: Vagash still terrorizes the herd!  Please help us by killing the wretched beast.
314-progress.title: Protecting the Herd

332-accept.name: Renato Gallina
332-accept.text:
If you talk to anyone about wine, then you know we Gallinas sell the best wine in Stormwind.  And we're not far, still in the Trade District along the city's lovely canals.

Here, take this pamphlet.  Bring it to my sister Suzetta at our shop for a complimentary bottle of our famous pinot noir.  You won't regret it!
332-accept.title: Wine Shop Advert

332-complete.name: Suzetta Gallina
332-complete.text: Ah, so you've seen Renato?  Well here you are, sir.  A bottle of our special pinot noir.  You'll not find its equal in all of Azeroth!
332-complete.title: Wine Shop Advert

332-progress.name: Suzetta Gallina
332-progress.text: Greetings and welcome, master.  Have you yet tried one of our fine wines?
332-progress.title: Wine Shop Advert

35-complete.name: Guard Thomas
35-complete.text: Yes, murlocs have settled in and around the streams of eastern Elwynn.  We don't know why they are here, but they are aggressive and at least semi-intelligent.
35-complete.title: Further Concerns

3524-accept.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-accept.text:
Majestic sea creatures are known to launch themselves at the Darkshore coastline, beached there until they die. Lately, these beasts have been washing ashore in ever-increasing numbers.  I've been sent here by the Temple of the Moon to investigate, but the presence of murlocs along the water has made my research difficult.

There is a giant creature washed ashore just south of Auberdine that is ringed by the foul Greymist murlocs.  Could you go there and retrieve bones from the creature for our study?
3524-accept.title: Washed Ashore

3524-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-complete.text:
I hope the murloc did not give you much trouble in collecting this for us!  I will be sure to get this on the next hippogryph to Darnassus.  The Temple of the Moon has given me some funds to hand out for assistance; please have some with our thanks.

Your success here emboldens me to offer you a chance to aid the Temple of the Moon further, if you are interested...
3524-complete.title: Washed Ashore

3524-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-progress.text: It is only recently that these creatures started landing on the coast of Darkshore in such alarming numbers.  I can't help but think that this is an ill omen of some sort.  Recovering a sample of that creature's bones to the south would help us in Darnassus assess this situation!
3524-progress.title: Washed Ashore

353-accept.name: Grimand Elmore
353-accept.text:
The Stormpikes are a respected dwarven clan, and are well known for their fine and discerning tastes.  So it's no wonder that Gringer Stormpike, a Mountaineer of Ironforge, commissioned me to craft him a weapon.

The weapon is finished, but... Mountaineer Stormpike is far away, in distant Loch Modan.  If you plan on traveling to the north, can you deliver this package to him?

My last message from Mountaineer Stormpike said he's stationed at the northern guard tower in Loch Modan.
353-accept.title: Stormpike's Delivery

353-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-complete.text:
Aha!  So Grimand finally finished my axe!  I can't wait to try it against some troggs and kobolds!

Many thanks, $N.  It was a long distance to travel for this delivery.   Here are some coins for your efforts.
353-complete.title: Stormpike's Delivery

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the $r lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

36-accept.name: Verna Furlbrow
36-accept.text:
I never thought the day would come when I'd leave the farm.  But the fields are overrun with thieves and it's far too dangerous for us here now.  As soon as Farmer Furlbrow gets the wagon fixed, we'll be on our way.  
 
Maybe you could do me a favor?  Let me scribble down my recipe for Westfall stew.  Please take it to Salma Saldean over on the farm yonder.  The Saldean's farm is just beyond the fork in the road.
36-accept.title: Westfall Stew

36-complete.name: Salma Saldean
36-complete.text: That Verna was always such a sweet lass.  We'll miss her here in Westfall but between you and me, she's a city girl at heart and Stormwind will suit her just fine.  But enough gossip!  Now we can make Westfall Stew!
36-complete.title: Westfall Stew

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

37-accept.name: Guard Thomas
37-accept.text:
A few days ago we sent two Guards, Rolf and Malakai, to investigate along the river, and they have not yet returned.  To complete my report, I must know what happened to those men.

Travel north along the river and find the guards... or their remains.
37-accept.title: Find the Lost Guards

37-complete.name: Unknown
37-complete.text: Although much has been stripped from the corpse, strewn nearby is a medallion with the words: "Footman Malakai Stone" etched upon it.
37-complete.title: Find the Lost Guards

38-accept.name: Salma Saldean
38-accept.text:
Help me make some Westfall Stew!  Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-accept.title: Westfall Stew

39-accept.name: Guard Thomas
39-accept.text:
Tell Marshal Dughan of Malakai and Rolf's deaths, and report to him that the Murlocs in eastern Elwynn cannot be contained by our current troop presence.

I know we don't have many troops to spare, but hopefully Dughan can find someone.
39-accept.title: Deliver Thomas' Report

39-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
39-complete.text:
Hmm, this news is troubling.  Already our defenses are stretched thin, and losing Rolf and Malakai to those murlocs put us in an even worse position.

If things don't improve, there will be fighting in Goldshire by the week's end!
39-complete.title: Deliver Thomas' Report

399-accept.name: Baros Alexston
399-accept.text:
It seems an eternity since I was a boy working the farm in Westfall. They say you can never go back, and it's true. Doubly true in my case, my family's home has been burned down and taken over by thieves.

I have spoken with my father about the fate of some of my possessions, including my first compass. He was unable to save them. However, he also says that they should be hidden away on the farm.

You'll find the Alexston Farmstead west of Sentinel Hill. Perhaps you could go and retrieve it for me?
399-accept.title: Humble Beginnings

416-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-accept.text:
We have a real infestation problem to the west.  Tunnel rat kobolds have moved into the foothills, setting up dens and fouling our land with their filth!

We want them eliminated.  Hunt them, bring me their ears and earn their bounty.

You can find tunnel rat kobolds and their dens west of Thelsamar, littered along the mountainside.
416-accept.title: Rat Catching

416-complete.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-complete.text:
Ugh!  When I asked for those ears I didn't realize they'd smell so bad!

Here's your reward, $N.  Well done.
416-complete.title: Rat Catching

416-progress.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-progress.text: Hail, $N.  How goes the rat catching?
416-progress.title: Rat Catching

417-accept.name: Unknown
417-accept.text:
Hildelve wrote in his journal that he was attacked by Mangeclaw, a "huge Ice Claw Bear."  He drove off the beast, but not before it mauled him savagely.

Judging from the state of Hildelve's body, Mangeclaw must have later returned and killed him.

However, Hildelve wrote in his journal his one, final wish:

Revenge against Mangeclaw.
417-accept.title: A Pilot's Revenge

417-complete.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-complete.text:
This is grim news, for Hildelve was a good friend.  And I wish I could have been there with you when you found the beast, Mangeclaw!

Thank you, $N.  Your deed will be remembered by the pilots of the Ironforge Siege Brigade.
417-complete.title: A Pilot's Revenge

417-progress.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have word of my friend Hildelve?
417-progress.title: A Pilot's Revenge

418-accept.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-accept.text:
There's never a shortage of empty bellies here in Thelsamar, kids running in and out, workers from the excavation coming in after  a hard day's work. We're famous for our blood sausages, I don't suppose you've ever tried them?

No? Well, around here you've got to work for your meals, and don't think just because you're a fancy $c, you'll be any exception.

I'll need bear meat, boar intestines for the casings, and spider ichor for spice. You get me some of those, and leave the cooking to Vidra!
418-accept.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

418-complete.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-complete.text:
Trust me, it seems a lot harder than it looks, but...

Oh, I've never known someone to take much interest in the making of sausages, but I'll give you the recipe just in case. Here you go, mind you eat them fresh!
418-complete.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

419-accept.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
419-accept.text:
My friend and fellow Siege Engine pilot, Mori Hildelve, is lost in the hills.  We were looking for a rare ore that's needed for a high-grade blastpowder, and during our search he drove his engine up a steep hill and busted it!

Still convinced that ore was in these mountains, Hildelve charged me to guard our engines while he continued on foot, searching.

It's been days, and I've heard some beastly growls in the hills at night.  Mori's tough as nails, but I'm worried.

Please, $N.  Find him.
419-accept.title: The Lost Pilot

419-complete.name: Unknown
419-complete.text:
Here is the corpse of a dwarf -- mauled, frozen, and picked clean by mountain scavengers.  Clutched in its hand is a book containing the roughly scribbled notes of Mori Hildelve.  And around its frame, still in superior condition, is a Brigadier's Vest.

This grisly scene must have been where the Siege Engine pilot met his end.
419-complete.title: The Lost Pilot

432-accept.name: Foreman Stonebrow
432-accept.text:
Those Light-blasted troggs, turning my work site into a wreck! Look at that, there goes another barrel of powder!

Ohhh, I wish I could go down there and wring every one of their scrawny little necks! I want to kill them all!

This can't be good for my health, all this stress and anger... What have they left me with? Nothing!

I'd kill them myself, but my aim's no good anymore! You go into the quarry and kill some of the filthy buggers! I'll pay you! Just hurt them, kill them!
432-accept.title: Those Blasted Troggs!

432-complete.name: Foreman Stonebrow
432-complete.text:
Well, that makes me feel a little better...

But I won't be happy until they're all dead! All of them!
432-complete.title: Those Blasted Troggs!

433-accept.name: Senator Mehr Stonehallow
433-accept.text:
As a member of the Senate and the Explorers' League, I've taken it upon myself to take care of this part of the trogg infestation that has gripped our lands.

They've certainly made a mess of Gol'Bolar quarry, and for no reason. As we dug deep into the earth, they poured out, destroying our equipment and driving the miners out. There's not much for us to do but to exterminate the lot of them, rebuild, then get back to work.

If you help me with the troggs, I'll gladly recompense you for your time.
433-accept.title: The Public Servant

433-complete.name: Senator Mehr Stonehallow
433-complete.text:
It is a start. Hopefully we can take advantage of it, and move some Mountaineers in to secure the area. Then we can begin to restore our infrastructure and get the miners back to work.

Thank you for your assistance, $N.
433-complete.title: The Public Servant

433-progress.name: Senator Mehr Stonehallow
433-progress.text: If we can remove the troggs from Gol'Bolar quarry, it will be the first step of many that we will have to undertake to rid ourselves of this menace.
433-progress.title: The Public Servant

45-accept.name: Unknown
45-accept.text:
Upon further searching the area, you find webbed footprints leading east along the shore of Stone Cairn Lake.  In the distance to the east, you can just barely see a Murloc village.

Perhaps Rolf's fate ended there...
45-accept.title: Discover Rolf's Fate

45-complete.name: Unknown
45-complete.text: You find around the neck of the corpse a metal medallion inscribed with the words "Footman Rolf Hartford."
45-complete.title: Discover Rolf's Fate

4681-accept.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-accept.text:
That beached creature is not an isolated incident here in Darkshore.  There are more along the coastline and even in the water.  I would like for you to investigate another one that we know of; this one was reported to be in the water due west of Auberdine, close to a sunken vessel.  Return to me with anything that you may recover that would aid our research.

Also, in your travels you may find other creatures.  By all means, if you should discover anything then please bring it to our attention!
4681-accept.title: Washed Ashore

4681-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-complete.text:
You've been a tremendous help here today; we now have a solid chance at unlocking the mystery of why these creatures choose to beach themselves on the coast of Darkshore.  The idea that they might be fleeing the area around Teldrassil is disturbing.  Should you come across others in your travels, please let me know.  Our research here is but in its infancy.

On behalf of the Temple of the Moon, please accept this as thanks for the effort you have given.  Thank you, $N!
4681-complete.title: Washed Ashore

4681-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-progress.text: Once you have investigated the creature's remains in the water to the west of here, I should be able to file a proper report with the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.  Perhaps then we will be closer to discovering the reason why these unfortunate creatures choose to end their lives beached on the coast of Darkshore.
4681-progress.title: Washed Ashore

47-complete.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-complete.text: Thanks for the dust, $N.  Here's your cash, and...here is a token from associates of mine.  You might find it useful...useful.
47-complete.title: Gold Dust Exchange

47-progress.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-progress.text: Psst!  You have that Gold Dust for me...for me?
47-progress.title: Gold Dust Exchange

4723-accept.name: Unknown
4723-accept.text:
The remains of a giant thresher - much larger than one you'd expect to find in Darkshore - lie beached on the coast of the Mist's Edge.  How this creature came to be here is unknown; the group of murlocs that now feast off the carcass of it seem to be much too weak, even in large numbers, to have brought down the beast. 

While some of it has been picked clean, enough of it remains to take a sample for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine to study.
4723-accept.title: Beached Sea Creature

4727-accept.name: Unknown
4727-accept.text: The skeletal remains of a sea turtle lie in the sand of the northern Darkshore beaches.  The Greymist murlocs have either not found this carcass, or perhaps they have and are shying away from it for some unknown reason.  Regardless, there is enough of the turtle left to take a sample back to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine for the Temple of the Moon to study.
4727-accept.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4740-accept.name: Unknown
4740-accept.text:
Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the murloc "Murkdeep".  This foul beast is known to be responsible for the death of at least one Sentinel, and is suspected of causing the sinking of at least two cargo vessels in the waters off Darkshore!

Murkdeep was last spotted at a hutted murloc camp south of Auberdine, and is thought to be protecting the huts there.  Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council
4740-accept.title: WANTED: Murkdeep!

4761-accept.name: Terenthis
4761-accept.text:
Your scouting of the furbolg camp is information that Thundris Windweaver should be made aware of.  He graciously serves as the elder of Auberdine, offering sage and just stewardship of the day to day affairs of the village.  Please - share with him your findings to date on the furbolg situation.

I believe he has some ideas of his own on the reasons behind their corruption.  Perhaps you can work with him to enact a plan to restore the balance of nature here!
4761-accept.title: Thundris Windweaver

4761-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
4761-complete.text: Well met, $c.  Your scouting of the furbolg situation comes at a fortuitous time for us in Auberdine.  For some time we have dealt with not only forest dwellers who are now openly hostile to our presence, but also the outright corruption of the forest itself.  Hopefully you might be able to lend Auberdine aid during these troubling times.
4761-complete.title: Thundris Windweaver

4762-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
4762-accept.text:
The Cliffspring River has begun turning foul and corrupted.  It empties into the Mist's Edge, and I fear the wash will affect Auberdine soon.  I suspect the Blackwood furbolgs up-river are the cause of the taint, but I also suspect that they aren't the true root of it.

Take this sampling tube and go to the mouth of the river to our north.  Proceed inland to the first waterfall and draw a sample from the pool there.  You'll see a bridge overhead.  Once you have a sample, return to me in Auberdine.
4762-accept.title: The Cliffspring River

4811-accept.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
4811-accept.text:
Hostile moonkin roam in ever increasing numbers to our east.  They once were thought to be gentle, almost mystical creatures.  While some continue to hold reverence for them, the safety of Auberdine forces me to keep a more realistic view.

I've received reports that moonkin are being drawn to a large red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain range.  No one has any idea what that crystal is, or even if it really exists.  I want you to locate it over there and report back to me what you find.
4811-accept.title: The Red Crystal

52-accept.name: Guard Thomas
52-accept.text:
Hail, $N.  Wild animals are growing more and more aggressive the farther we get from Goldshire, and the Eastvale Logging Camp suffers nearly constant attacks from wolves and bears!

We could use your help out here.
52-accept.title: Protect the Frontier

52-complete.name: Guard Thomas
52-complete.text:
Thanks a lot for the help, $N.  Something in the forest must be making these animals so bold.

Whatever it is, I hope it stays there.
52-complete.title: Protect the Frontier

52-progress.name: Guard Thomas
52-progress.text: Have you killed those wolves and bears?
52-progress.title: Protect the Frontier

5545-accept.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-accept.text:
I've got a real problem on my hands. I have a deadline looming for an order of lumber, and I'm running out of time. The wolves and bears north of here have chased my workers away from the bundles of wood that they've already chopped.

I've already talked to Deputy Rainer about clearing the animals, but I need someone to go collect the wood for me. If you could collect eight bundles of wood for me I might just make my deadline.
5545-accept.title: A Bundle of Trouble

5545-complete.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-complete.text:
Excellent! Thanks to you, I should be able to complete the order in time. To show my gratitude, I would like to offer some coin as compensation for your troubles.

Thank you and farewell.
5545-complete.title: A Bundle of Trouble

5545-progress.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-progress.text: That deadline isn't getting any further away, $c. Please hurry and collect those bundles of wood.
5545-progress.title: A Bundle of Trouble

59-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
59-accept.text:
For your shrewdness and valor, I have a marker here that is good for one piece of armor.  I want you to take it to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp.  Give her the marker, and she will fashion the armor for you.  And after you receive it, $N, use it in the defense of Elwynn.

The Eastvale Logging Camp is beyond Guard Thomas' post to the east.
59-accept.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

60-complete.name: William Pestle
60-complete.text: You were busy hunting kobolds, were you?  Thanks for the candles, $N, and here's your reward...
60-complete.title: Kobold Candles

60-progress.name: William Pestle
60-progress.text: Did you gather those candles yet?
60-progress.title: Kobold Candles

61-accept.name: William Pestle
61-accept.text:
My brother Morgan is waiting in Stormwind for my shipment of candles.  I don't have enough time to make the trip myself, but if you'd like to take him the shipment, he'll pay you well.

I've packed up the candles, and you can find Morgan in our shop, Pestle's Apothecary, in the Stormwind Trade District.
61-accept.title: Shipment to Stormwind

61-complete.name: Morgan Pestle
61-complete.text: Here is your payment ... and while you're here, take a look around!  I'm sure we have a potion or other trinket you'd find useful.
61-complete.title: Shipment to Stormwind

61-progress.name: Morgan Pestle
61-progress.text: Oh, a shipment from my brother?  Splendid!  Fortune truly shines on me today!
61-progress.title: Shipment to Stormwind

6181-accept.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6181-accept.text:
Although we don't get much aid from Stormwind directly, I do have a contact in the city who helps supply us with armor.  His name is Osric Strang.  His shop, Limited Immunity, is in the Old Town of Stormwind.

Our supply of armor dwindles, and I must contact Osric for more.  Can you take him this note?

The fastest way to Stormwind is through Thor, our gryphon master.  He's just down the hill; bring him my note, and then take a gryphon to Stormwind.
6181-accept.title: A Swift Message

6181-complete.name: Thor
6181-complete.text: You have to get this note to Stormwind?  That's not a problem, you can take one of my gryphons!
6181-complete.title: A Swift Message

6181-progress.name: Thor
6181-progress.text: You look like you're in a hurry.  Well, then you came to the right place!
6181-progress.title: A Swift Message

62-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
62-complete.text: This is bad news.  What's next, dragons?!?  We'll have to increase our patrols near that mine.  Thanks for your efforts, $N.  And hold a moment... I might have another task for you.
62-complete.title: The Fargodeep Mine

6261-accept.name: Osric Strang
6261-accept.text:
$N, I gathered into this crate everything Lewis asked for.  Can you take it to him?

If you've already spoken to Thor in Westfall, then you can take a gryphon back to him.  Dungar Longdrink is our gryphon master, over in the trade district.

Speak with Dungar, then get this crate to Lewis as fast as you can.  We don't want our fighting men and women in Westfall to go without fresh equipment!
6261-accept.title: Dungar Longdrink

6261-complete.name: Dungar Longdrink
6261-complete.text: A crate for Westfall, eh?  Have you been to Westfall before?  If so, then it's no problem, my friend.  I have plenty of gryphons trained to fly that route!
6261-complete.title: Dungar Longdrink

6261-progress.name: Dungar Longdrink
6261-progress.text: Is that sweat on your brow, lad?  You've been running too much.  Next time, take a gryphon!
6261-progress.title: Dungar Longdrink

6281-accept.name: Thor
6281-accept.text:
For a small fee, you can take a gryphon to Stormwind, so you can deliver Lewis' note to Osric.  You won't get there faster any other way.

If that sounds acceptable, then just speak to me again when you're ready for the ride.  I'll charge you a little, but trust me; it'll be worth it!
6281-accept.title: Continue to Stormwind

6281-complete.name: Osric Strang
6281-complete.text:
Ah, a note from Quartermaster Lewis?  I'm not surprised he needs more gear.  Sentinel Hill is far away, in a land Stormwind has all but forgotten.

Well thank you, $N.  Here's some money to cover your travel costs.
6281-complete.title: Continue to Stormwind

6281-progress.name: Osric Strang
6281-progress.text: You've been traveling, eh?  Have you been anywhere interesting?
6281-progress.title: Continue to Stormwind

6285-accept.name: Dungar Longdrink
6285-accept.text:
The gryphon master in Westfall is Thor.  If you've spoken to him before, then you can take one of my gryphons to him.

That's a good lesson to know: gryphons are always trained to fly to their capital city, but they'll only take you to a remote gryphon master after you've already been there.

You've already been to Thor, so just speak with me again when you're ready to take a gryphon to Westfall.  Once there, you can deliver Osric's Crate to Quartermaster Lewis.
6285-accept.title: Return to Lewis

6285-complete.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6285-complete.text:
Great, you brought the armor!  We'll get this divvied to those who need it immediately.

Thank you, $N.  Your efforts have been a great help to us.  And now that you're no stranger to gryphons, I hope you'll come and lend your aid to Sentinel Hill often!
6285-complete.title: Return to Lewis

6285-progress.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6285-progress.text: You're back from Stormwind?  Did Osric send the armor?
6285-progress.title: Return to Lewis

64-accept.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-accept.text: It was horrible!  Verna woke me when she heard a ruckus in the fields.  The fields were full of hooligans.  We left in a rush and I forgot to pack my pocket watch.  Verna's pa gave me that watch on our wedding day and I feel just sick knowing those thieves have it.  I left the pocket watch in the wardrobe at the farmhouse.  Look for the field of pumpkins to the West -- you can't miss it.  If you bring it back to me, I'd sure be grateful!
64-accept.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

6661-accept.name: Monty
6661-accept.text:
Avast ye scallywag. Arrrr... Arrrr ye looking fer work? We gots a serious rat problem down here an' not enough hands on the poop deck.

What do ye say? All ye needs to do is take this here rat catchin' flute and play the melody around the vermin. They'll follow ye to the ends of the world!

Just capture five of the little buggers and bring em back here. We needs em alive.

Arrrrr...
6661-accept.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6661-complete.name: Monty
6661-complete.text: These'll werk nicely, matey. Me brother needs em still tickin' and kickin,' else they go sour... Ye don't want to taste no sour rat kabob.
6661-complete.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6661-progress.name: Monty
6661-progress.text: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
6661-progress.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

71-accept.name: Unknown
71-accept.text: Now that you have both medallions, deliver them to Guard Thomas at the bridge so that he might know the fate of his murdered guards.
71-accept.title: Report to Thomas

71-complete.name: Guard Thomas
71-complete.text: You have confirmed my fears, $N.  The murlocs are a threat we cannot ignore.
71-complete.title: Report to Thomas

71-progress.name: Guard Thomas
71-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
71-progress.title: Report to Thomas

76-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
76-accept.text:
Thanks to you we know the Fargodeep Mine is infested with kobolds.  Now we need a scout to investigate the more distant Jasperlode Mine.

Explore Jasperlode and confirm any kobold presence.  To reach the mine, travel east along the road until you reach the Tower of Azora.  From the tower, head north and you'll find the mine in the foothills.
76-accept.title: The Jasperlode Mine

76-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
76-complete.text:
Kobolds at the Jasperlode Mine, you say?  Curses!  The situation is worsening by the minute!

Thank you for the report, $N.  But I wish that the news you brought was good news.
76-complete.title: The Jasperlode Mine

83-accept.name: Sara Timberlain
83-accept.text:
The Defias gang in Northshire wears burlap masks, but the Defias in Elwynn wear linen which I can use to make fine linen goods.

Bring me red linen bandanas and I'll use them to fashion something for you.

Defias gang members have camps pocketed throughout Elwynn.
83-accept.title: Red Linen Goods

83-complete.name: Sara Timberlain
83-complete.text:
Ah, these are nice bandanas, if a little rough...

Here you are!
83-complete.title: Red Linen Goods

83-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
83-progress.text: I'm running low on linen, $N.  Do you have any for me?
83-progress.title: Red Linen Goods

84-accept.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
84-accept.text: Here you go.  And when you give this pie to that Billy, you tell him I hope he chokes on it!
84-accept.title: Back to Billy

84-complete.name: Billy Maclure
84-complete.text:
Mm, yum!  This pie is the best!

I think my memory is coming back to me...
84-complete.title: Back to Billy

84-progress.name: Billy Maclure
84-progress.text: Ugh... I'm starving!  Do you have that pie for me, $N?
84-progress.title: Back to Billy

85-accept.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
85-accept.text:
I lost my necklace, and think that guttersnipe Billy Maclure took it!  He's usually scuttling like a rat around the Maclure vineyards east of here. 

Get my necklace back for me, and you'll warm an old widow's heart.
85-accept.title: Lost Necklace

85-complete.name: Billy Maclure
85-complete.text:
You lost a what?  Well I didn't take no necklace, because I ain't no thief!

I might know who did but...<grin>...I'm too hungry to remember.
85-complete.title: Lost Necklace

86-accept.name: Billy Maclure
86-accept.text:
