Maybe if I got a pie, I could tell you who has that necklace.  And you know, I think that old Bernice lady at that other farm makes great Pork Belly Pies... 

Maybe if you gave her some chunks of boar meat from the boars that hang around our farms, and told her what it was for, she'd bake up a pie for you.
86-accept.title: Pie for Billy

86-complete.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
86-complete.text: Though this wild boar meat is tough, simmer it enough and it sure does make for some tasty pie!
86-complete.title: Pie for Billy

86-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
86-progress.text:
I don't think it's right feeding the boy who stole my necklace in the first place, but if that's what it takes to get back what's mine, then so be it!

Do you have that boar meat?
86-progress.title: Pie for Billy

87-accept.name: Billy Maclure
87-accept.text:
I was playing near the Fargodeep Mine, and I think I dropped, er...I mean I saw, the old lady's necklace.  Don't ask me how it got there...it wasn't me!

Well anyway, I saw this big, gold-toothed kobold pick up the necklace and run into the mine.  Go find that kobold and you'll find the necklace, I swear!
87-accept.title: Goldtooth

87-complete.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
87-complete.text:
Oh, you found it!  Thank you, thank you dear!

Here, take this.  It was my husband's and he always said it was lucky.  If only he didn't forget it on his last campaign! *sniff*
87-complete.title: Goldtooth

87-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
87-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found my necklace?
87-progress.title: Goldtooth

88-accept.name: Ma Stonefield
88-accept.text:
The Brackwells have a prize-winning pig, Princess.  The sow is HUGE, and she got that way from sneaking over here and eating my veggies!

So before she comes to our fields...Princess must die!  Bring me her collar as proof of the deed and I'll give you something for your time!

Princess is usually over at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, to the east and beyond the Maclure farm.  Get her before she gets hungry and comes back here!
88-accept.title: Princess Must Die!

88-complete.name: Ma Stonefield
88-complete.text:
Thank goodness!  That pig was getting so big she'd have eaten our whole crop!  Thank you, $N.

Now, do either of these suit you?
88-complete.title: Princess Must Die!

88-progress.name: Ma Stonefield
88-progress.text: Did you see her yet?  Did you get her?
88-progress.title: Princess Must Die!

9-accept.name: Farmer Saldean
9-accept.text:
Look at what has happened to this place!  These lands were once occupied by good farm folk.  But the damned thieves have driven them all off.  Not me, though!  But it seems some Harvest Watchers have taken over the fields.

If you're up for the work, I'd like you to go out and kill twenty of them.  Come back when you're done for your pay.  If you finish up with the ones in my field, clear them from the neighboring fields as well.
9-accept.title: The Killing Fields

91775-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91775-progress.text: Have you found all the books yet?
91775-progress.title: Book Return

91777-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91777-progress.text: Have you found all my missing books yet?
91777-progress.title: Rare Books

947-accept.name: Barithras Moonshade
947-accept.text:
I am devising a potion that requires rare mushrooms, mushrooms that grow only in a certain cave.  The cave lies behind Cliffspring Falls, to the east and slightly north along the mountains.

I would go there myself, but I was advised by the Grove of the Ancients to stay away from that place.  Our venerable allies sense that the cave is the hiding place for a new evil in Darkshore.

Please, $N, gather the mushrooms for me.  And while doing so, scout the cave to confirm the Ancients' fears.
947-accept.title: Cave Mushrooms

95065-progress.name: Gilbert Gray
95065-progress.text: Did you get the fishing supplies?
95065-progress.title: Fishin' Time

95214-progress.name: Quarrymaster Thesten
95214-progress.text: I hope you've got good news for me?
95214-progress.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

954-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
954-accept.text:
The ruins of Bashal'Aran to the east are overrun with demonic minions. The sprites and satyrs that have taken up residence in the area feed upon the magical energies of the area, their powers growing from continued exposure.

Even with that, I have noticed that there is one shrine they will not approach. On the western side of the ruins, atop a small bluff, a strange blue aura permeates... There must be an explanation to the demons' reluctance.

I would like you to investigate it.
954-accept.title: Bashal'Aran

963-accept.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-accept.text:
In the aftermath of the battles at the Well of Eternity, I heard that Ameth'Aran had been destroyed, its people dead, including my love, Anaya.

I would never have thought, thousands of years later, that memories of Anaya would still haunt my dreams. Wandering the woods of Darkshore in a stupor, I found myself in the ruins of Ameth'Aran... where I saw the haunted spirit of my beloved.

She must be freed, but I lack the heart to do it. Her spirit must be destroyed.
963-accept.title: For Love Eternal

982-accept.name: Gorbold Steelhand
982-accept.text:
Off the coast of Darkshore to our north are two wrecked ships - the Silver Dawning and the Mist Veil. Some time ago, both ships ran afoul of the blasted murlocs as they sailed across the vast sea into Auberdine. They now lie at the bottom of the ocean as trophies for those fiends.

Both captains didn't make it out that night, and their logs and other effects are still below in lockboxes. I'd like for you to recover them for us; it would mean a lot to the crew members still around these parts.
982-accept.title: Deep Ocean, Vast Sea

983-accept.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
983-accept.text:
Hey! Help me with my latest invention, the buzzbox. You can talk to people far away!

Maybe you've already seen them, they're boxes with levers on them. The only problem is they need constant maintenance.

Each one suffers from a different problem, but I made a really smart decision. I placed each one near creatures that have the proper parts to fix that particular machine. Right now Buzzbox 827 is on the fritz. It's just south of Auberdine, real close. It takes 6 Crawler Legs to fix it. I'll pay ya...
983-accept.title: Buzzbox 827

983-complete.name: Unknown
983-complete.text:
As you place the Crawler Legs inside the machine, you hear gears begin to grind. Judging from the banging sounds coming from the Buzzbox, you believe the Crawler Legs are being put in their proper place. Soon the machine begins to hum, and you hear a tiny voice calling out from within.

"Hello? Uhh... Hello! You fixed it! This is Wizbang by the way! Thanks a lot... Hey, you wouldn't want to fix another one, would ya?"
983-complete.title: Buzzbox 827

983-progress.name: Unknown
983-progress.text: Buzzbox 827 sits with an eerie silence. A single flashing light indicates that it needs 6 Crawler Legs to be placed in its holding box.
983-progress.title: Buzzbox 827

984-accept.name: Terenthis
984-accept.text:
Some of my brethren were rescued from a corrupt furbolg in Teldrassil, and I've vowed to stop any more atrocities before more of our kind are injured... or worse.

I have seen a couple hints of corruption in Darkshore already, but I have yet to find any widespread signs. I think it would be logical if the investigation continued with the furbolgs. Would you find one of their camps, and return to me if you see any signs of corruption?
984-accept.title: How Big a Threat?

984-complete.name: Terenthis
984-complete.text:
This is terrible news indeed, $N.

With the furbolgs this close to Auberdine, we will have to prepare ourselves for the inevitable.

Thank you, $N.
984-complete.title: How Big a Threat?

985-accept.name: Terenthis
985-accept.text:
You've already proven adept at scouting our enemy, $N. Do you have what it takes to fight them as well?

Not all adventurers prefer straightforward combat to the art of stealth and evasion.

If you think you're up for the task, then the furbolg camp south of Auberdine is currently the biggest threat to our people. You'll find some of the Blackwood tribe there. Kill 8 pathfinders and 5 windtalkers, and return to me here.
985-accept.title: How Big a Threat?

99143-progress.name: Lee Brown
99143-progress.text: What did you find? Anything interesting?
99143-progress.title: Bottles and Baubles
